thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: high 5xx rate for inference-service in us-west-2 (AZ2). Trigger: 503 spike > 12% over 5m. PD: <https://pagerduty.example/INC123456|INC123456>

pagerduty: Incident INC123456 triggered by service: inference-service. Escalation policy: SRE oncall -> platform team.

mike_oncall: acking now. I'm oncall for this window, taking primary.

elena_sre: thanks - can you grab initial blast radius and any customers hitting errors? run `kubectl -n inference get pods` and `kubectl logs` for the failing pods.

mike_oncall: running checks. Pod counts look fine but pod `inference-az2-0` is OOMKilled and restarting a lot. Logs show `runtime: kv cache mem pressure` and repeated `oom` from worker-0.

jay_platform: copying: we've seen KV cache growth after large-context requests. Could be a bad request pattern from a customer. Can we throttle or evict cache on that node?

anita_engineering: if it's cache pressure we can flip a config to reduce `kv_cache_size` to 0.5x on the AZ2 pool. That is a rolling config but quick. Risk: slight latency increase.

mike_oncall: proposing immediate mitigation: 1) Mark AZ2 as degraded in routing to stop new sessions 2) Evict cache on affected nodes 3) Kick a canary fallback to us-west-1. Thoughts?

elena_sre: +1 to marking AZ2 degraded. Add a `route: failover` tag on the load-balancer so the smart router uses other zones. I'll open a short-lived failover in console.

incident-bot: Routing policy update applied: `us-west-2: az2 -> degraded`; fallback target: `us-west-1, us-east-1`. TTL: 15m.

sam_ops: I can run the eviction script now: `scripts/evict_kv_cache.sh --nodes inference-az2-*` — will coordinate with infra.

mike_oncall: go ahead sam. Also start burst scaling on us-west-1 dedicated pool to absorb traffic: `redwoodctl scale --pool us-west-1-dedicated --factor 1.5`

anj: (typo)

jay_platform: I see autoscaler reaction is currently suppressed by policy; overriding now to allow extra nodes in us-west-1. Doing `kubectl patch hpa inference --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'`.

anita_engineering: FYI we pushed a model rollback in AZ2 earlier tonight as part of canary, that version had a different cache behavior. Could be correlated. We should note for postmortem.

mike_oncall: mitigation timeline: 00:00 - PD alert fired. 00:02 - acked by me. 00:04 - marked AZ2 degraded. 00:06 - eviction script started. 00:09 - scaling us-west-1 initiated. Current hit: 503 rate dropped from 12% -> 3.2% but still above baseline.

elena_sre: customer impact: preliminary list from logs shows 4 customers with elevated errors (corp-ads, chat-pro, search-rl, partner-batch). corp-ads and chat-pro are user-facing with visible 5xx. I've DM'd customer-success with suggested communication.

pagerduty: INC123456 status: acknowledged by mike_oncall. Next escalation window in 8 minutes if not resolved.

sam_ops: eviction completed on 6/6 nodes in AZ2. Memory pressure dropped, pods stabilized. Restart counts back to normal.

mike_oncall: re-route remains active for safety. I'm going to keep monitoring for 30m and then do a controlled un-degrade if stable.

elena_sre: running a smoke run against corp-ads and chat-pro endpoints: corp-ads OK now (latency slightly up), chat-pro shows intermittent 502s still. I've flagged it as partial-impact.

anita_engineering: can we enable a rate-limit in front of long-context jobs? quick patch: `limit_request_length: 20000` on the proxy for AZ2 traffic, but since AZ2 is degraded the hit is small. Consider applying to us-west-1 if we see similar patterns.

jay_platform: noted for follow-up. For immediate lift: I'll roll back the earlier canary in AZ2 (model v2.18 -> v2.17) to remove the cache regression. Rolling now with `kroll -n inference v2.17 --target az2`.

mike_oncall: roll complete. Observing metrics... 503 rate trending down to 0.8% across the region.

elena_sre: starting handoff: my shift ends in 25m. mike, can you mark the incident status and we'll prepare a short post-incident summary? Also list customer-impact windows and mitigation steps.

mike_oncall: yes. I'll capture timeline and actions. Will escalate to platform-led postmortem if we confirm model rollback triggered pattern.

incident-bot: Note: Temporary routing TTL expires automatically at 15m from now. If extended, please run `incident-bot extend-route --inc INC123456 --ttl 30m`.

pagerduty: INC123456 update: resolved? false. Current urgency: high.

mike_oncall: marking `in progress` -> `stabilizing`. I'll keep this thread live; if anyone sees regression ping me.

elena_sre: :thumbsup: prepping notes for postmortem. Will include: root cause hypothesis (model cache regression), mitigation (evict cache, rollback model, route degrade), customer impact list, follow-ups (add kv cache instrumentation, gating for canary).

sam_ops: logs/timeseries saved to: `/var/logs/incidents/INC123456/` and a snapshot uploaded to S3 `s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC123456/`.

mike_oncall: thanks everyone. Final status in 20m unless escalation needed. I'll hand off to elena (on PM) for postmortem creation.

elena_sre: handing off docs to anita for engineering write-up after I finish timeline.

anita_engineering: on it. I'll include config diffs and the exact request patterns that triggered KV growth.

mike_oncall: closing note: impact window ~ 00:00-00:12 in AZ2; degraded routing and rollback prevented broader outage. Good job.

incident-bot: Channel reminder: please add `#incident-postmortem` tag and set severity in the postmortem doc when ready.
